title: Briton among six dead after gunman opens fire in Kraków market square
summary_full: Three more people found dead at home of suspect, who minister says held ‘ultra-nationalistic’ viewsSix people were killed and 16 wounded after a gunman opened fire in a busy market square in Kraków, authorities said, in what Poland’s defence minister called an “act of terror” on the people of the city.The suspect, a 25-year-old Polish citizen, opened fire with an automatic weapon in the city’s main square at about 3pm on Saturday before being apprehended by police.
